map.屏幕上连续出现字母、位置或图形，你需要判断当前这一个是否与前面第 N 个相同。N: Letters, positions or shapes appear one after another on screen, and you judge whether the current one matches the one N steps back. Larger N means harder (1-back is easiest, 3-back is already challenging). This is the most widely used paradigm in cognitive training research and can improve working memory and attention.
map.可调 N 值（1-back 到 3-back 及以上）: Adjustable N (1-back up to 3-back and beyond)
map.刺激类型可选字母 / 位置 / 双 N-back: Stimulus type can be letters / position / dual N-back
map.难度随 N 自适应或手动设定: Difficulty adapts with N or is set manually
map.纯前端运行，数据不上传: Runs purely in the frontend, no data uploaded
map.认知训练：系统提升工作记忆容量: Cognitive training: systematically build working memory capacity
map.研究参与：复现经典 N-back 范式: Research participation: replicate the classic N-back paradigm
map.专注力练习：每天几组保持状态: Focus practice: a few sets per day to stay in form
map.选择 N 值（新手从 1-back 起）与刺激类型: Choose N (beginners start at 1-back) and the stimulus type
map.记住前面第 N 个刺激是什么: Remember what the stimulus N steps back was
map.当前刺激出现时判断是否匹配: Judge whether it matches when the current stimulus appears
map.答对继续，答错看反馈后继续: Continue if correct; if wrong, read the feedback and continue
map.逐步把 N 调到 2、3 提升难度: Gradually raise N to 2 or 3 to increase difficulty
map.2-back 已接近多数人的舒适上限: 2-back is already close to the comfortable upper limit for most people
map.双 N-back（同时看字母和位置）难度陡增: Dual N-back (tracking letters and positions at once) is sharply harder
map.先把 1-back 练到几乎全对再升 N: Practice 1-back until nearly perfect, then raise N
map.保持节奏，过快易错、过慢记不清: Keep the pace: too fast invites mistakes, too slow hurts recall
map.N-Back 工作记忆训练 - 在线工具: N-Back working memory training - online tool
map.研究显示对训练任务本身提升明显，迁移到日常其他任务存在争议，但作为脑力锻炼有普遍: Research shows clear gains on the trained task itself, while transfer to other everyday tasks is debated, but it has general value as mental exercise.
map.N 越大越好吗？: Is a larger N always better?
map.不是，超过自己能力太多只会挫败；在能做对七八成的难度最利于提升。: No; exceeding your ability by too much only brings frustration. A difficulty where you get about 70-80% correct is most conducive to improvement.
